newsitem.title: USA: Nashua sees pretax loss of $3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nashua sees pretax loss of $3 mln.

text.p: Nashua Corp said Thursday it completed the sale of its $29 million (in-revenue) mainland European film processing operations to Spector Photo Group N.V., a Belgian-based film processor.
Nashua said it received about $5 million in net proceeds from the sale and expects to record a pretax loss of about $3 million from the transaction in the fourth quarter.
On November 18, Nashua had announced that it was in negotiation to sell these operations.

The company said the units sold include mail-order photofinishing services in France, Belgium, the Netherlands and Spain. These units, along with a film-processing operation in Northern Ireland, were purchased by Nashua in January 1995. Nashua said it is retaining the Northern Ireland-based business.
